function.arguments: {"observation": "The cross-tabulation of `channel` vs `customer_segment` shows a significant imbalance: the email channel has 131 loyal customers and 131 returning customers, while the paid_search channel has only 26 loyal and 153 returning. The email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (loyal and returning), which means the two channels are not comparable. Any raw comparison of conversion or revenue between channels will be confounded by customer segment.", "implication": "The raw difference in conversion rate or revenue between email and paid_search cannot be attributed to the campaign itself. The email group has a higher proportion of loyal customers, who are more likely to convert regardless of the campaign. Therefore, to estimate the true campaign effect, we must adjust for customer segment — either by stratifying, standardizing, or modeling the effect. Failure to do so would result in a biased estimate. The analysis must now be stratified by customer segment."}
function.name: note_finding
